trivia: Before 'Agent Z Reacts to the Nintendo Direct ft. Neo Agent 3', videos were posted twice a week. This stopped to give agent z more time to work on longer videos, as seen with 'The SPIDER'.
While most Inklings and Octolings used squid or octo shaped phones, a specfic phone model featuring 3 cameras can be seen used by Pearl, indicating that its a phone for a wealthy class.

Both 'Clash of the Agents' and the 'Battle of Inkopolis Square' episodes attempt to feature the Deca Tower from Inkopolis Square in the thumbnail, with the latter being a bit more successful as it is green-screened on.

'Stories of the Agents' was planned to have more scenes, such as more dialogue and scenes dedicated to Agent X and Agent Z fleeing the building they were in. These were scrapped due to either time constraints or tp shorten the video.
Agent Z does not mind the intermissions in Mario Kart World and finds them enjoyable occasionally. Agent X holds a differing, more negative opinion to them.
In 'Power Outage', when Shiver begins giving instructions, she reads from a piece of paper with DRSABCD on it, a common first-aid protocol in Australia. She starts from Response (R).
The initial thumbnail for Locked Out was meant to be only temporary due to it being made quickly to get the video out of time.
Prior to 'Enter SM64', agent z 100%'d their save file on Super Mario 64 from Super Mario 3D All-Stars. Before, it had just been completed at 70 stars.
Neo Agent 3's pose in the render 'To Break Into A Home' is one of agent z's personal favorite renders.
While titled similarly, 'agent z Versus' is not an intentional reference to 'Nintendo Versus', official branding for Nintendo's competitive tournaments.
Agent Z being bad at the guitar as seen in the Splatshort 'Agent Z's Guitar Solo' parallels with Agent X being good at the guitar and playing it since her childhood.
Background characters, as well as Agent Z and X themselves use the same type of phone in videos.
Agent Z's computer now has a sticky note with the letter 'W' on it, referencing 'Fireworks Festival' where she names the computer 'Agent W'.

Bonus: flattered that you're interested enough to go looking in the code (:
